fields.statement: At aa2f5da1c: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run Review passes, incl. TestReviewFixerPreHandoffChecklist, which slices review.md between '## Fixer' and '## Outside work' and asserts 'reproduce your findings', `rhiza ship generate`, `rhiza render`, '`Checks:` block' and 'exit code'; the whole guide package passes too (token caps). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow passes, incl. TestFixerPromptsNameChecksBlock asserting the review.toml fixer prompt and ship-change.toml ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix prompts each name the `Checks:` block, rhiza ship generate, rhiza render and exit code. Read the diff: review.md fixer section and the four prompts (plus gate-fix-merge and conflict-fix-landed) say to run reproducing commands, then rhiza ship generate and rhiza render before the one commit, with a Checks: block of commands and exit codes.
